summary: Carded out of MPI-413 Pod testing. UNIVERSAL ops break on a Pod volume because code-only node packs reach the volume only via a MODEL dep list. universal_workflows.js lines 5-7 promise universal deps install WITH the engine, and shared.js checkUniversalWorkflowDepsStatus delivers that for the LOCAL engine only - there is no remote twin, so baked packs ride the image while the 7 code-only packs are model-gated. Live proof on Pod jtoo2fl2xgtt5y volume 9t3awufudk: Resize Video died with missing_node_type VHS_LoadVideoPath, Pod object_info had 1822 node types and zero VHS_*, remote/model-present said comfyui-videohelpersuite present:false while control comfyui_ultimatesdupscale said present:true. NOT an MPI-413 regression - the deleted wrapper code only ran requirements for an already-extracted folder and never downloaded a node. Measured blast radius: VideoHelperSuite needed by resizeVideo, declared by 2 of 18 models (wan-22, wan22-5b); comfyui-inpaint-cropandstitch needed by appHeadSwap, declared by 3 of 18 (klein-4b, boogu-edit-high, boogu-edit-balanced) - a SECOND live-broken op nobody reported, kept alive by MPI-332; MpiNodes needed by all 12 ops but declared by all 18, so broken only on a zero-model volume. Sweep trap recorded: local custom_nodes/ComfyUI-MpiNodes is a SYMLINK so readdir withFileTypes isDirectory() is false and every Mpi* class vanishes from the index.

Implementation started. Option A chosen by the user: ensure the code-only UNIVERSAL node packs exist on the Pod volume on EVERY connect, matching what the local engine already does at boot. Rejected: lazy per-graph install (needs a graph-to-pack map at dispatch and still stalls mid-generation). Shape: shared.js exports the universal dep OBJECTS; remoteModels.ensureUniversalNodesOnVolume() keeps custom_nodes deps that are NOT _isImageResident, one batched remoteModelsCheck to find the absent ones, remoteInstallDep each (wrapper stamps .mpi_node_commit from getPinnedNodeCommit), poll until they land, then ONE ComfyUI restart; remotePodLifecycle fires it once per Pod, non-blocking, when /remote/comfy/status first sees the wrapper ready. A complete volume costs one batched status call and nothing else.

Code landed, suite green, live verification NOT claimed. shared.js getUniversalWorkflowDeps() returns the universal DEP objects; remoteModels._universalVolumeNodeDeps() selects the code-only packs (exactly 7, with 16 baked/weight deps excluded) and ensureUniversalNodesOnVolume() does one batched remoteModelsCheck, installs each missing pack via remoteInstallDep so the wrapper stamps .mpi_node_commit from getPinnedNodeCommit, polls the same check to a 60s deadline, and restarts ComfyUI ONCE if anything landed; remotePodLifecycle._ensureUniversalNodes() fires it once per podId, non-blocking, the first time the wrapper reports comfy_ready. A complete volume costs one batched status call and nothing else. New guard tests/universal-nodes-remote.test.cjs asserts the SHIPPED selection, not a copy of it. Four sabotages run: dropping the _isImageResident filter, dropping VideoHelperSuite, and an id-less dep were all caught; the fourth (removing the id stamp in getUniversalWorkflowDeps) PASSED and that was the useful one - all 112 DEPS entries already self-identify, so the spread was dead code carrying a comment that misstated the data, and both were deleted. Suite 390/0, eslint 0 errors and 0 new warnings (routes/remoteModels.js:695 has a pre-existing unused eslint-disable, confirmed on the unmodified file, left alone). NOT VERIFIED LIVE: no Pod was running, so ensureUniversalNodesOnVolume has never executed against a wrapper - the install/poll/restart sequence is code-verified only and folds into the MPI-413 image test.

Session ended with the card in doing, maturity validating. Code complete and suite-green at 390/0, with validation.md holding the diagnosis, the measured blast radius and the four-sabotage table. ZERO live verification - ensureUniversalNodesOnVolume has never executed against a wrapper. Needs the same Pod boot as MPI-413: on a volume with no Wan 2.2 and no Klein/Boogu, Resize Video AND Head Swap must both succeed.
